integrity.attribution: Original historical works are cited; no authorship or independent assessment is imputed.
integrity.proof_basis: Positive weighted combination of four of five pentagon support constraints, weighted AM–GM, explicit simultaneous-contact rectangle and exact fifth-support slack identity; trigonometric endpoint comparison.
integrity.scientific_limitations: No theorem for nonregular pentagons or odd polygons of larger order; the geometric candidate and its numerical area appeared conditionally in a 2017 public discussion; an exhaustive historical priority audit is not asserted.
integrity.scientific_scope: Regular Euclidean pentagon of circumradius \(R>0\); arbitrary inscribed Euclidean rectangles; sharp fixed-orientation maximum, globally sharp area and exact five-rectangle equality classification.
integrity.verification: Analytic all-orientation proof with a standalone standard-library numerical identity verifier; the verifier is supplementary and not an infinite proof.

title: The exact area–orientation envelope for rectangles in a regular pentagon
